in: Shake on a penny a stair
Ask her for your purse back
Ask Master Harker about the wool
Tell Master Harker you are the Squire
Show Master Harker the printed tally
court: Stand up and shake the Reeve
Tell Abel that Harker has bought
supper: Ask Master Harker to show you
shake: Walk down to the Glove Post with Master Harker and shake on the flock, for the twenty
Tell Callow: a hand binds the one who shook it, if he knew
landing: Give the hired their hands back
